title: Omastar's Fangs Couldn't Save Its Hunt

direction.premise: Omastar had rock-crushing fangs, but its heavy shell limited the prey it could reach.
direction.audiencePromise: See how Omastar's strongest weapons still failed against its hunting problem.
direction.openLoop: How could a rock-crushing hunter still fail to catch food?
direction.payoff: Omastar's hunting design worked nearby, but failed when food stayed out of reach.
direction.engagementQuestion: Crushing fangs or a lighter shell, which would you choose?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a sharp surprise. Keep the pace quick, warm, and conversational. Stress the contrast between crushing power and limited reach.

scenes.headline: CRUSH ROCK. LOSE PREY.
scenes.narration: Omastar crushes rock, yet its shell loses prey.
scenes.caption: POWERFUL BITE. FATAL LIMIT.

scenes.headline: SHARP FANGS, HUGE POWER
scenes.narration: Its sharp fangs could crush rock, a brutal advantage.
scenes.caption: THE BITE ISN'T THE LIMIT

scenes.headline: PREY MUST COME CLOSE
scenes.narration: But tentacles had to bring prey into biting range.
scenes.caption: GRAB FIRST. BITE SECOND.

scenes.headline: THE SHELL BECAME THE TRAP
scenes.narration: Then the shell grew too large and heavy, slowing movement.
scenes.caption: BIG SHELL. SLOW MOVEMENT.

scenes.headline: POWER STILL WASN'T ENOUGH
scenes.narration: Even strong fangs and tentacles could not prevent extinction.
scenes.caption: STRONG WEAPONS. NO ESCAPE.

scenes.headline: POWER ONLY WORKS UP CLOSE
scenes.narration: Its hunting design worked nearby, but failed when food stayed out of reach.
scenes.caption: NEARBY FOOD: POSSIBLE. DISTANT FOOD: LOST.
